page.title: Audios
page.subtitle: Create speech, music, and sound effects.

speech.title: Text to speech
speech.hint: Read text aloud with a voice.

effects.title: Sound effects
effects.hint: Create a sound from a description.

model.removeDescription: The model file is removed from this computer and frees {{size}}. Your clips stay.
model.unavailable: Downloads open once the audio engine can run on this computer.

engine.rowDescription: Runs speech, music and sound effect models.

coreTooOld.title: Audio needs a newer Atomic Chat
coreTooOld.body: The engine in this version of the app cannot generate audio yet. Update the app to use this page.

coreUnreachable.title: Waiting for the engine
coreUnreachable.body: The app’s engine is not answering yet. This page picks up as soon as it does.

noBuild.title: No audio engine for this computer
noBuild.body: No audio.cpp build is published for this computer yet.

install.title: Install the audio engine
install.body: audio.cpp runs the models on this computer.

form.textPlaceholder: Enter the text to read aloud…
form.resetHint: Restore audio settings. Your text stays.
form.voiceHint: The model’s other voices appear here after it starts.
form.speedHint: Speaking rate. 1 is the normal speed.
form.lyricsPlaceholder: Words to sing. Leave empty for an instrumental.
form.durationHint: Length of the clip in seconds.
form.tempoHint: Beats per minute. Empty lets the model choose.
form.stepsHint: More steps take longer. Empty uses the model’s own count.

disabled.coreTooOld: Audio needs a newer version of Atomic Chat.
disabled.coreUnavailable: The engine is not answering yet.
disabled.needsVoiceRef: This model speaks only in a cloned voice, which this page cannot record yet. Pick another model.

gallery.title: Gallery

empty.title: Your audio appears here
empty.description: Enter a prompt and generate audio.

gallery.emptyNoModel: Download an audio model to get started.

delete.title: Delete this clip?
delete.description: The audio file and its recipe are removed from this computer.

ENGINE_MISSING.title: The audio engine is not installed
ENGINE_MISSING.body: Install it to generate audio on this computer.

ENGINE_INSTALL_FAILED.title: The audio engine did not install
ENGINE_INSTALL_FAILED.body: The download or its check failed. Try installing it again.

ENGINE_CRASHED.title: The audio engine stopped
ENGINE_CRASHED.body: It stopped during the job. Try again; the engine starts again by itself.

MODEL_MISSING.title: The model file is missing
MODEL_MISSING.body: Download the model again from the list.

MODEL_LOAD_FAILED.title: The model did not start
MODEL_LOAD_FAILED.body: The engine could not load it. Try again, or choose a smaller model.

MODEL_INCOMPATIBLE.title: This engine cannot run the model
MODEL_INCOMPATIBLE.body: Choose another model, or update the audio engine.

MODEL_NOT_LOADED.title: The model is not running
MODEL_NOT_LOADED.body: It stopped before the job started. Generate starts it again.

OUT_OF_MEMORY.title: Not enough memory for this model
OUT_OF_MEMORY.body: Close other models or apps, or choose a smaller model.

UNSUPPORTED_BACKEND.title: This computer cannot run the audio engine
UNSUPPORTED_BACKEND.body: No build of the engine fits this hardware.

UNSUPPORTED_MODE.title: Another model is running
UNSUPPORTED_MODE.body: The running model does not make this kind of audio. Try again to start the right one.

INVALID_REQUEST.title: These settings cannot be used
INVALID_REQUEST.body: Check the text and settings, then try again.

REQUEST_REJECTED.title: The model refused these settings
REQUEST_REJECTED.body: Change the settings or the text, then try again.

INVALID_OUTPUT.title: The engine returned no audio
INVALID_OUTPUT.body: Try again, or try another seed.

JOB_BUSY.title: The engine is busy
JOB_BUSY.body: Another job is running. Try again when it finishes.

JOB_NOT_FOUND.title: The job is gone
JOB_NOT_FOUND.body: The engine no longer knows this job.

DISK_FULL.title: The disk is full
DISK_FULL.body: Free some space, then try again.

BACKEND_IN_USE.title: The model is in use
BACKEND_IN_USE.body: Wait for the job to finish, then try again.

INTERNAL.title: Something went wrong
INTERNAL.body: The engine reported an unexpected error. Try again.
